svg.title: Anchor: intent-driven collaboration and software layers
svg.desc: Panel a: a person expresses an intent on the canvas in the browser; the browser resolves the marks to element ids; Anchor stores the intent; the user's agent harness pulls it, reads the canvas and sources, and replies with questions, suggestions or direct additions; Anchor stages or applies them; the person reviews in place. Panel b: inside one environment, the HTTP, MCP and CLI entry points share one project runtime. The pure core holds the intent and workspace services. Producer extensions (PDF, FMU, CAD, SysML) plug in beside it; the PDF extension resolves source references and may call an optional model API outside the environment, only if the environment allows egress. Infrastructure implements the storage and event ports over plain project files: intents, canvases and documents in bronze, silver and gold layers.
svg.text: Pull it via MCP or CLI
Canvas changes reach every open view over SSE, including writes from other processes. Intents send only a pending signal; the browser then
pulls the thread from the project store.
trust boundary: provider, endpoint and local-only mode hold for every project
one composition root per project; every entry point shares its services
no files, no network, no vendor SDKs
File stores · In-process event bus · Event-log tailer for other processes · Presence and activity log
plain files in .anchor_data, shared by anchor serve, anchor-mcp and the CLI
Source refs on nodes and rows
